source_title: 'Historic day': PM Modi welcomes launch of Kashi-Delhi Vande Bharat sleeper train
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: Indian Railways has launched the second Vande Bharat sleeper train, connecting Varanasi (Kashi) with New Delhi via Prayagraj and Kanpur Central, expanding the network of overnight semi-high-speed rail services. With the launch of the Kashi-Delhi Vande Bharat Sleeper Train, not only will there be a saving of time, but their experience is also set to improve. Equipped with modern amenities and a state-of-the-art safety system, this is the countryâs second Vande Bharat Sleeper Train,â he wrote.In another post, Modi highlighted the route's significance for pilgrims, tourists and business travellers, noting that the train would connect several important destinations across Uttar Pradesh.âThe Vande Bharat Sleeper train running from Kashi to Prayagraj, via Kanpur Central, to Delhi will make travel convenient for millions of devotees, tourists, youth, and businesspeople,â he said.Emphasising the cultural and religious importance of the route, the Prime Minister added, âWhether itâs a darshan of Baba Vishwanath or a journey to the Sangam, this train will connect faith with opportunity and tradition with modernity. Heartfelt best wishes to everyone for this new rail service!âThe new service will connect Varanasi, one of India's prominent spiritual and cultural destinations, with the national capital, while also improving connectivity for passengers travelling through Prayagraj and Kanpur.The 16-coach train will offer three accommodation classes: third AC, second AC and first AC and has a passenger capacity of 823.The service is expected to operate six days a week, covering approximately 760 km.
